rowAddNode.result: The new root is appended to the current scene, not the clicked non-current scene, and no history command is created.

rowAddLights.result: The clicked sceneID is absent from the command envelope; current and non-current rows route to the current scene.

rootRowDrop.result: The clicked sceneID is ignored and ReparentNodeCommand receives newParent=-1 using the current-scene parent map.

O01.result: AChild -> A0 is a semantic and runtime no-op, but execute clears seeded redo and pushes one Move command.

O02.result: Both root-row drops are semantic and runtime no-ops, but each clears seeded redo and pushes one Move command; clicked sceneID is not passed.

O03.result: Undo appends X to the old parent tail instead of restoring its original sibling slot.

O04.loadedFixtureResult: Scene::load injects a Camera root, so [Root, Camera] is not a unique-root fixture and Root is actually deleted.
O04.taskPredictionConflict: The semantic document is invariant, but sceneGraphRevision changes 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 and runtime SHA-256 changes at every checkpoint.
O04.executionBoundary: The exact confirmed-delete command/domain envelope was executed without instantiating the reference modal or ImGui runtime.

o09Coverage.reason: All 298 CPU/domain matrix cells executed in fresh processes with exact source-derived command envelopes, but ImGui, Vulkan/GPU, and screenshot/visual runtime layers were not executed.
